# Feature 2: dynamic synergy in event resolution

## Summary
When resolving `evt-grand-opening`, use the placed cards synergies from `placedSynergiesThisTurn` (union semantics) instead of the static `event.targetSynergy` in all three engine paths: `resolveEvent`, `applyCompetitiveEventEffects`, `computeOwnerEventDeltas`.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Resolve `evt-grand-opening` after a Food placement: coin delta = 450 × (grid cards sharing Food synergy), Commerce cards excluded unless they also share Food.
2. Multi-synergy placed card (`Food|Culture`): any grid card sharing any placed synergy counts (union, consistent with existing `synergyTypes.includes`).
3. Community-space placement drives the synergy selection symmetrically.
4. All three engine paths (`resolveEvent`, `applyCompetitiveEventEffects`, `computeOwnerEventDeltas`) resolve the same dynamic synergy.
5. Static `targetSynergy: Commerce` remains in `card-data.csv`; the override is a resolution-time keyword check on `evt-grand-opening`.
6. No behaviour change for other `SpecificSynergy` events (festival, rainy, etc.).

## Dependencies
Depends on Feature 1 state model (MS-0MVCS1NOH0074YY2).
data.title: Feature 2: dynamic synergy in event resolution

# Feature 3 Tests: projection parity

## Summary
Tests asserting AI/projection value equals actual payout for the dynamic synergy in both single-player and competitive modes, including piggyback projection and animation attribution.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Test single-player: `projectEventCoinDelta` == actual `resolveEvent` payout for Food-placement scenario.
2. Test competitive: `computeCompetitiveEventValue` == per-owner `computeOwnerEventDeltas` payout.
3. Piggyback projection path equals expected dynamic reward.
4. `scoreEventAction` value consistent with the dynamic payout.
5. Animation attribution (`MainStreetAdjacencyScoring`) marks the dynamic-match slots. Full suite passes.
data.title: Feature 3 tests: projection parity

# Feature 4 Tests: tooltip/doc consistency

## Summary
Tests asserting the card tooltip/effect text is consistent with the new dynamic synergy payout, and that tooltip consumers (`event-card-tooltip-info.test.ts`, `event-tooltip-card-text-consistency.test.ts`) still pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Tooltip text for `evt-grand-opening` no longer contains \"Commerce promotion\".
2. Card catalog/doc copy asserts no fixed-Commerce claim.
3. Existing tooltip tests updated and passing after the copy change.
4. Full project suite passes.
